:::{#thm-conditional-entropy-iterated}
#### Conditional entropy as an iterated expectation

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,
the [conditional entropy](#def-conditional-entropy) of $Y$ given $X$
is the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) over $X$
of the [conditional expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cond-expectation) of the [conditional surprisal](#def-conditional-surprisal) given $X$:

$$\entropyf{Y \mid X} = \Expfc{X}{\Expfc{Y \mid X}{\surprisalf{Y \mid X} \given X}}.$$ {#eq-conditional-entropy-iterated}

:::

::: {.proof}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{Y \mid X}
&= \Expfc{X, Y}{\surprisalf{Y \mid X}} \\
&= \Expfc{X}{\Expfc{Y \mid X}{\surprisalf{Y \mid X} \given X}}.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-conditional-entropy-iterated-2}

The first line is @def-conditional-entropy,
and the second is the [law of iterated expectations](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#thm-lie).

For discrete $X$ and $Y$, the second line regroups a double sum
over the pairs $(x, y)$ with $\P(X=x, Y=y) > 0$:

$$
\sum_{x, y} \P(X=x, Y=y) \, \surprisalf{y \mid x}
= \sum_{x} \P(X=x) \sum_{y} \P(Y=y \mid X=x) \, \surprisalf{y \mid x}.
$$ {#eq-conditional-entropy-iterated-3}

Each [conditional surprisal](#def-conditional-surprisal) is nonnegative,
because a conditional probability is at most $1$.
So [Tonelli's theorem](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#thm-fubini-tonelli-measure) allows the regrouping
with no integrability condition,
and the two sides are equal even when the conditional entropy is infinite.

:::
